```{r}

files <- list.files("texts",
                    pattern = "\\.txt$",
                    full.names = TRUE)

texts <- tibble(
  doc_id = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)),
  text = map_chr(files, read_file)
)

print(texts)
```
